warnings.message: npm 11.6.0 (packageManager in package.json) runs every dependency install script and has no allow-list, so "deny" cannot be enforced there
warnings.fix: Require npm 11.16.0 or later in packageManager in package.json (npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default)

warnings.message: npm 11.6.0 does not support min-release-age and allow-git (added in 11.10.0), allow-remote, allow-file and allow-directory (added in 11.15.0), allowScripts (added in 11.16.0); not written
warnings.fix: Require npm 11.16.0 or later where the version is pinned
